intro.text: A Torish yoki-hijo, active in the reform movement, whom Hwanji once served as an attendant.

items.text: As a reformed yoki-hijo, Dwookim made her own decisions and fed and bathed herself. Late in her career she worked only about half of each week, summoning around ten spirits a session. Hwanji was one of her attendants for several years before Dwookim retired.
